items.title: Gartner (IT) Says Quantum Will Sit Out Enterprise AI Through 2028
items.summary: Gartner forecasts that enterprise AI workloads at scale will not use quantum hardware through at least 2028. The company expects quantum AI to remain focused on research and development while classical accelerated AI continues to lead in production workloads. This guidance frames how large enterprises may plan AI and quantum computing budgets over the next several years.
